entry.title: Downloading an artifact is not proof it is the approved build
entry.summary: Bind approval to a specific workflow run and artifact digest, then verify that same object at deployment.

entry.title: When architecture changes, keep the superseded ADR
entry.summary: Preserve the old decision, link its replacement, and separate architectural intent from migration completion.

entry.title: No CSP reports does not prove an enforcement policy is ready
entry.summary: Verify reporting and workflow coverage before enforcing CSP; an empty report stream is not proof of safety.

entry.title: Is SameSite alone enough to prevent CSRF?
entry.summary: Evaluate SameSite against the application threat model and protect state-changing requests with explicit checks.

entry.title: A Docker secret mount cannot prevent a command from leaking its input
entry.summary: Secret mounts protect a build input channel; inspect commands, output files and caches for copied credentials.

entry.title: Keep diagnostic evidence without creating a second sensitive database
entry.summary: Log decisions and correlation identifiers while controlling sensitive fields, access and retention.

entry.title: A dialog can close while leaving keyboard users lost
entry.summary: Define dialog entry, contained keyboard navigation and the next focus destination, matching semantics to behavior.

entry.title: Does readOnly in OpenAPI actually prevent a write?
entry.summary: In OpenAPI 3.1.1, readOnly is an annotation; define and verify the actual server-side write policy.

entry.title: Tail sampling cannot recover traces already discarded upstream
entry.summary: Tail sampling selects received traces; upstream drops, routing and decision windows still constrain error coverage.

entry.title: Row locks can still deadlock: order resources across every entry point
entry.summary: Prevent PostgreSQL deadlocks with consistent resource ordering across writers, and retry at the transaction boundary.

entry.title: A JSONB GIN index does not support every query shape
entry.summary: Match PostgreSQL JSONB operator classes and indexed expressions to real queries before evaluating cost.

entry.title: Pagination needs a unique order and a cross-page consistency policy
entry.summary: Use a unique order for PostgreSQL pagination, and define what concurrent changes may do between pages.

entry.title: Why can a unique column still contain multiple NULLs?
entry.summary: PostgreSQL 18 treats NULLs as distinct in unique constraints by default; choose semantics before enforcing identity.

entry.title: More clicks, fewer completed tasks? Define the denominator first
entry.summary: Define attempts, completion and observation windows before interpreting a rise in product clicks.

entry.title: One metric label per order turns monitoring into an event database
entry.summary: Budget label combinations before exposing metrics, and keep unbounded event identities in suitable diagnostic storage.

entry.title: Promise.all rejection does not cancel the remaining work
entry.summary: Promise.all aggregates outcomes; cancellation, compensation and complete result collection need separate policies.

entry.title: Terraform state locking does not freeze the cloud
entry.summary: State locking coordinates a state backend, not every cloud writer; establish ownership before clearing a lock.

entry.title: A timestamp offset cannot fully express “every day at nine”
entry.summary: Store an occurrence separately from recurring calendar intent, and define how local-time ambiguities are handled.

entry.title: Image uploads need more than extension and MIME checks
entry.summary: Quarantine untrusted uploads and review parsing, storage and retrieval permissions as well as file type.

entry.title: A smooth demo does not prove usability: write tasks without giving the answer
entry.summary: Test the goal without giving away the route, and distinguish independent completion from moderator assistance.

entry.title: A Dependency Cache Hit Is Not Proof of a Valid Release
entry.summary: Treat dependency caches as disposable acceleration inputs while preserving lockfile checks and artifact provenance.

entry.title: Two Deployments Overlap: Should the Lock Follow the Branch or the Environment?
entry.summary: Coordinate deployment writers around the target environment and verify final state after cancellation or overlapping runs.

entry.title: If a Workflow Does Not Pass a Token, Can an Action Still Access It?
entry.summary: Limit GITHUB_TOKEN permissions per job and inspect implicit token access before trusting build and publication boundaries.

entry.title: Both Saves Succeeded: Why Did One Editor Lose Their Changes?
entry.summary: Combine strong ETags with atomic version checks and a conflict workflow that preserves unsaved edits.

entry.title: Can a Timed-Out Request Be Retried? Define the Business Idempotency Boundary
entry.summary: Define stable intent and durable deduplication before retrying an order whose outcome is unknown.

entry.title: Search Results Went Backward: Cancellation Also Needs a State-Commit Guard
entry.summary: Combine request cancellation with identity guards on results and errors so older search responses cannot replace current intent.

entry.title: Why Does no-cache Still Leave Cached Files?
entry.summary: Distinguish no-cache from no-store and private by checking validation and reuse across the actual delivery chain.

entry.title: Does Replacing Order Numbers with UUIDs Prevent Unauthorized Access?
entry.summary: Keep object-level authorization independent of UUID guessability across downloads and asynchronous results.

entry.title: Users Say They Would Use It: Ask About the Last Real Task First
entry.summary: Use recent task evidence to test product assumptions without confusing polite agreement with demand.

entry.title: Database Slowness Restarts Every Pod: Is the Probe Asking the Wrong Question?
entry.summary: Match Kubernetes startup and readiness checks to their actions while reserving liveness restarts for appropriate failures.

entry.title: The Node Is Idle: Why Is the Container Still Slow?
entry.summary: Separate Kubernetes requests from runtime limits and correlate container constraints with queues and business latency.

entry.title: preStop Is Configured but Requests Still Fail: Budget the Whole Shutdown
entry.summary: Budget Kubernetes termination across hooks and in-flight work with observable completion rather than fixed sleep.

entry.title: Why Should Customer Email Not Go Straight into OpenTelemetry Baggage?
entry.summary: Separate OpenTelemetry Baggage propagation from telemetry storage and keep sensitive data and authorization outside its trust.

entry.title: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY Is Still Waiting: What Should a Release Check?
entry.summary: Plan PostgreSQL 18 concurrent index builds around transaction waits and validity rather than command completion alone.

entry.title: A Query Is Slow: Check Row Estimates Before Adding an Index
entry.summary: Locate row-estimate errors and actual execution work in PostgreSQL 18 before choosing an index or query rewrite.

entry.title: Both Transactions Committed: Why Did the Business Invariant Fail?
entry.summary: Protect PostgreSQL 18 business invariants with suitable concurrency controls and bounded whole-transaction retries.

entry.title: The Backup Job Is Green: Why Does Recovery Still Fail?
entry.summary: Validate PostgreSQL 18 recovery through roles and restored business behavior instead of a successful backup-job status.

entry.title: The Database Committed but the Notification Failed: Define the Handoff
entry.summary: Use a transactional outbox to make handoff recoverable while defining worker ownership and duplicate delivery handling.

entry.title: The Key Was Deleted from Git: Why Is the Incident Not Over?
entry.summary: Verify replacement access and old-credential rejection across declared consumers instead of relying on source deletion.

entry.title: A Server Fetches User URLs: Why Is Domain Validation Not Enough?
entry.summary: Bound server-side URL fetching through destination policy and redirect checks backed by controlled network egress.

entry.title: A successful deployment is not a verified release
entry.summary: Separate source, artifacts, deployment, and user outcomes; rehearse rollback with data compatibility in mind.

entry.title: “Support export” is not an acceptance criterion
entry.summary: Use an export workflow to separate acceptance scenarios, interface boundaries, and architecture decisions.

entry.title: Green tests are not enough: design quality gates around failure paths
entry.summary: Prioritize logic, integration, end-to-end, security, and accessibility checks by the failures they detect.

entry.title: Low CPU, failed users: connect service indicators to incident learning
entry.summary: Distinguish accepted requests from completed jobs, define indicator populations, and make incident actions verifiable.
